user.title: Add a Weight Coach
user.description: Pick the weight sensor to coach against — e.g. a Medisana BLE Scale weight sensor. One Weight Coach is set up per person.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Used for the BMR/TDEE calorie math. Prefilled from the weight sensor if it already reports these.

data.milestone_count: Number of milestones along the way

activity.title: Activity level
activity.description: Prefilled with a guess from the weight sensor's activity attribute if present — adjust if it doesn't match your real activity level.

error.source_unavailable: Could not read a current value from that sensor.
error.goal_must_be_below_start: Goal weight must be below your current weight for a loss goal.
error.goal_must_be_above_start: Goal weight must be above your current weight for a gain goal.

init.title: Weight Coach options
init.description: Attach a metabolic-rate sensor for graphing, without losing your existing history (unlike deleting and re-adding this integration).
